proposal.summary: A command injection vulnerability in the inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service in Druva inSync Windows Client 6.6.3 allows a local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM by bypassing path validation via a directory-traversal suffix.
proposal.cwe_quote:
Command injection in inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service
The path validation has been only implemented through a 'strncmp' function which can be bypassed by appending a directory traversal escape sequence at the end of the valid path.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Apply the vendor's patch or upgrade to a fixed inSync Windows Client version. If a patch is not available, restrict access to the service socket (localhost only) and remove or mitigate the privileged service until a vendor fix is available.
